entries.title: Romans 10:9
segments: Because if thou shalt confess, etc.  The apostle here explains the conditions of salvation as implied in the preceding verse and follows the order there indicated, thus making confession first and faith second.  His meaning is that faith, which is really first, is valueless unless it results in confession.

entries.title: Romans 10:14
segments:
,15
 
In whom they have not believed. An argument for the conversion of the heathen.  In these verses the apostle meant to emphasize the truth that the Jews themselves ought to have sent missionaries to proclaim the Messiah to Gentiles.

entries.title: Romans 10:17
segments: The word of Christ. See note on

entries.title: Romans 10:18
segments: But I say, Did they not hear? At this time the gospel message had been proclaimed in all the chief cities of the Roman empire which had a Jewish population.

entries.title: Romans 10:19
segments: But I say, Did Israel not know? Had Israel not received prophetic warning that the Gentiles would accept the Messiah, and that the Jews themselves would reject him?  Both Moses and Isaiah proved the contrary.

entries.title: Romans 10:20
segments: Isaiah is very bold. Very certain and specific.
